title: The actual open coefficient mate is invertible
statement: Let R,S be coefficient families and a:R→S a compatible coefficient change [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. For an open immersion j:U→V of schemes and any ambient derived R_U-module M, the actual scalar-adjunction mate openComparison(a,j)_M of [def-sp-coefficient-mate-comparisons] is an isomorphism. The specified open unit and restriction normalization are those of [def-sp-open-coefficient-adjunction-data]. No flatness of a or constructibility of M is assumed.

from.place: The normalized open coefficient mate needed by the finite comparison in the scalar projection realization.

source.place: Tag 0E8I; the existing openComparison_isIso declaration and its unit-normalized mate, IntegralCompactSupportCoefficientComparison.lean.

proof.text: For the identity morphism of the underlying scheme with coefficient map a.map, apply the normalized open base-change isomorphism of [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. Its inverse is specified as the open adjunct of the scalar pullback of the actual open unit. This gives the geometric isomorphism without a flatness hypothesis on the coefficient map.

source.place: Tag 0E8I; the existing openComparison_isIso declaration and its unit-normalized mate, IntegralCompactSupportCoefficientComparison.lean.

proof.text: Transport the scalar pullback presentation to the actual scalar extension pbcDerivedExtend used in [def-sp-coefficient-mate-comparisons]. Both scalar functors are left adjoints to the same exact restriction. The unit equation for uniqueness of left adjoints identifies their adjunction transposes. The coefficient change square identifies the open restrictions, and the open unit normalization identifies the ordinary restriction comparison.

source.place: Tag 0E8I; the existing openComparison_isIso declaration and its unit-normalized mate, IntegralCompactSupportCoefficientComparison.lean.

proof.text: Under these transports, the inverse of the normalized geometric isomorphism and the inverse scalar-adjunction mate defining openComparison have the same adjunct. Injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence identifies the arrows. Isomorphism is preserved under these presentation identifications, proving IsIso for the specified openComparison at every ambient derived input. In particular this argument supplies the exact existing helper used by QcqsCompactSupportFiniteMates; it uses no full integral compact-support comparison or projection theorem.
